results.name: Words of Affirmation
results.tagline: Say it, and you feel it.
results.body: For you, love lives in language — a genuine 'I'm proud of you' can carry you for days. You notice words others forget, both the kind and the careless. When someone tells you what you mean to them, it lands deeper than any gesture.
results.youGrowWhen: you ask for the words you need instead of waiting for them.

results.name: Quality Time
results.body: You don't want grand gestures — you want someone fully there, phone down, eyes up. Undivided attention feels like love in its purest form. Time is the one thing that can't be faked, and you feel the difference instantly.
results.youGrowWhen: you speak up for the focused time you deserve.

results.name: Acts of Service
results.body: You believe in showing, not just telling. When someone lightens your load without being asked, it hits you right in the heart. You give the same way — quietly handling things for the people you love.
results.youGrowWhen: you let others take care of you too.

results.name: Physical Touch
results.body: A hand on your shoulder can say more than a paragraph. Touch grounds you, reassures you, brings you home. Without it, even a good relationship can feel a little far away.
results.youGrowWhen: you ask for the closeness you need, out loud.

results.name: Receiving Gifts
results.body: For you, a gift isn't about price — it's proof that someone was thinking of you when you weren't around. You keep the little tokens, the notes, the small surprises, because each one is a moment of being seen.
results.youGrowWhen: you remember your worth isn't measured in gestures.
